claims: Seychelles is a 115-island archipelago nation in the Indian Ocean.
Seychelles is located northeast of Madagascar.
Mahé is home to capital Victoria.
All visitors must apply for a Travel Authorization before travel to Seychelles.
Mahé, Praslin, and La Digue are the main visited islands in Seychelles.
Roughly 100,000 residents live on the islands of Seychelles.
Seychellois culture stems from French, British, and African influences.
The official languages of Seychelles are Seychellois Creole, English, and French.
Travelers must obtain a Travel Authorization (approx. €10.90) via the official Seychelles Electronic Border System before arrival in Seychelles.
Seychelles is located outside the cyclone belt.
Average temperatures in Seychelles are between 26°C and 28°C.
Basic accommodation in Seychelles often exceeds $130 per night.
Seychelles has public beaches with granite boulders including Anse Source d'Argent and Beau Vallon.
Vallée de Mai is a protected nature reserve on Praslin.
